# Ocufuse

> Ocufuse is an eye health journal and eye games app on the web, with an iPhone app launching October 23, 2026. It offers three free browser games for screen breaks on ocufuse.com (Shade Hunt, Dot Chase, Edge Spot; no download, free with an email address, no account needed), visual games and guided eye exercises in the app (including companions for exercises clinicians give for lazy eye, strabismus and convergence insufficiency), comfort routines for eye strain, a daily log, optional eye photos and a Doctor Brief to share with an eye care professional. Ocufuse is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. It is free to start; Ocufuse Plus costs $7.99 a month (3-day free trial), $49.99 a year (7-day free trial) or $119.99 once for Lifetime. Web app: https://app.ocufuse.com

## Product
- [Ocufuse: eye log, screen-break games and a Doctor Brief](https://ocufuse.com/): Free eye games for screen breaks, a daily eye log and a Doctor Brief to share with your eye doctor. Free to start in your browser.
- [Ocufuse Doctor Brief: A Guide for Eye Care Clinicians](https://ocufuse.com/clinicians): For ophthalmologists, optometrists, orthoptists and GPs: what an Ocufuse Doctor Brief contains, how patients make it, and its limits.
- [Safety, intended use and eye warning signs](https://ocufuse.com/safety): What Ocufuse is for and what it is not for, plus the eye warning signs that need a doctor straight away, such as sudden vision loss or double vision.
- [Ocufuse Plus: Plans, Pricing and Free Trial](https://ocufuse.com/plus): Ocufuse Plus unlocks every eye game, your full history, all 24 guides and the Doctor Brief. $7.99 a month, $49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $119.99 once.
- [Ocufuse for iPhone: eye log and eye games app](https://ocufuse.com/app): Ocufuse for iPhone: a daily eye log with a reminder, eye games for short breaks, and sync with the web app. Launching October 23, 2026. Join the waiting list.

## Free eye games
- [Free eye games you can play in your browser](https://ocufuse.com/games): Three free eye games for screen breaks: Shade Hunt, Dot Chase and Edge Spot. No download, free with your email, a minute or two each, on phone or computer.
- [Shade Hunt: find the odd tile, a free screen-break game](https://ocufuse.com/games/shade-hunt): Find the tile that is a slightly different color. A free 60-second browser game for screen breaks: the grid grows as the shades get closer. Free with email.
- [Dot Chase: follow the dot, a free screen-break game](https://ocufuse.com/games/dot-chase): Follow the moving dot with your eyes and catch it when it changes colour. A free two-minute eye tracking game for screen breaks, on phone or computer.
- [Edge Spot: watch the edges, a free screen-break game](https://ocufuse.com/games/edge-spot): Keep your eyes on the centre cross and spot the diamond that flashes at the edges. A free peripheral vision game for screen breaks, with six levels.

## Eye exercises
- [Eye exercises: what the research says and how to track them](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/): Do eye exercises improve vision? What eye exercises can and can't do, the techniques clinicians prescribe, what the research says, and how to log them.
- [Convergence insufficiency explained: symptoms, diagnosis and research](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/convergence-insufficiency): What convergence insufficiency is, its symptoms, how it is diagnosed, and what the CITT trial and Cochrane review found. A plain guide; treatment decisions are for your eye care professional.
- [Pencil push-ups and the Brock string explained](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/pencil-push-ups-brock-string): How pencil push-ups and the Brock string work, why clinicians prescribe them for convergence insufficiency, and what the CITT trial found.
- [The 20-20-20 rule and digital eye strain explained](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/20-20-20-rule): What the 20-20-20 rule is, how digital eye strain happens, what a 2022 study found about screen breaks, and simple screen setup tips from eye care experts.
- [Eye exercise myths: palming and the Bates method](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/myths): Can eye exercises replace glasses? What eye care organisations say about palming, the Bates method and eye exercises for dyslexia.
- [Eye exercise log: tracking prescribed exercises](https://ocufuse.com/eye-exercises/exercise-log): What to record when doing prescribed eye exercises at home, a simple log format, and how to bring it to your orthoptist or optometrist.
- [Ejercicios oculares: qué dice la investigación y cómo registrarlos](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/): ¿Los ejercicios oculares mejoran la vista? Lo que pueden y no pueden hacer, las técnicas que indican los profesionales, las pruebas del CITT y Cochrane, y cómo registrar los ejercicios indicados.
- [Insuficiencia de convergencia explicada: síntomas, diagnóstico e investigación](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/insuficiencia-de-convergencia): Qué es la insuficiencia de convergencia, sus síntomas, cómo se diagnostica y qué encontraron el ensayo CITT y la revisión Cochrane. Una guía sencilla; las decisiones de tratamiento corresponden a tu profesional de la visión.
- [Flexiones con lápiz y el cordón de Brock explicados](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/flexiones-con-lapiz-y-cordon-de-brock): Cómo funcionan las flexiones con lápiz y el cordón de Brock, por qué los indican los profesionales para la insuficiencia de convergencia y qué encontró el ensayo CITT.
- [La regla 20-20-20 y la fatiga visual digital: ¿funciona?](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/regla-20-20-20): Qué es la regla 20-20-20, qué es la fatiga visual digital, qué encontró un estudio de 2022 sobre las pausas de pantalla y los consejos de la AOA para la pantalla.
- [Mitos sobre los ejercicios oculares: palming, método Bates y gafas](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/mitos): ¿Pueden los ejercicios oculares sustituir a las gafas? Lo que dicen las organizaciones de salud visual sobre el palming, el método Bates y los ejercicios para la dislexia.
- [Registro de ejercicios oculares: anota los ejercicios indicados](https://ocufuse.com/es/ejercicios-oculares/registro-de-ejercicios): Qué anotar al hacer en casa los ejercicios oculares indicados, un formato de registro sencillo y cómo llevarlo a tu ortoptista u optometrista.
- [Göz egzersizleri: araştırmalar ne diyor ve nasıl takip edilir](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/): Göz egzersizleri görmeyi iyileştirir mi? Neleri yapıp neleri yapamadıkları, uzmanların önerdiği teknikler, CITT ve Cochrane kanıtları ve önerilen egzersizlerin nasıl kaydedileceği.
- [Yakınsama yetmezliği açıklandı: belirtiler, teşhis ve araştırmalar](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/yakinsama-yetmezligi): Yakınsama yetmezliğinin ne olduğu, belirtileri, nasıl teşhis edildiği ve CITT çalışması ile Cochrane derlemesinin bulguları. Sade bir rehber; tedavi kararları göz sağlığı uzmanınıza aittir.
- [Kalem egzersizi ve Brock ipi nedir](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/kalem-egzersizi-ve-brock-ipi): Kalem egzersizi ve Brock ipinin nasıl çalıştığı, uzmanların bunları yakınsama yetmezliği için neden önerdiği ve CITT çalışmasının bulguları.
- [20-20-20 kuralı ve dijital göz yorgunluğu: işe yarar mı?](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/20-20-20-kurali): 20-20-20 kuralı nedir, dijital göz yorgunluğu nedir, 2022 tarihli bir çalışma ekran molaları hakkında ne buldu ve AOA'nın ekran önerileri.
- [Göz egzersizleri mitleri: palming, Bates yöntemi ve gözlük](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/mitler): Göz egzersizleri gözlüğün yerini alabilir mi? Göz sağlığı kuruluşlarının palming, Bates yöntemi ve disleksi için göz egzersizleri hakkında söyledikleri.
- [Göz egzersizi kaydı: önerilen egzersizleri takip edin](https://ocufuse.com/tr/goz-egzersizleri/egzersiz-kaydi): Önerilen göz egzersizlerini evde yaparken neleri kaydetmeli, basit bir kayıt formatı ve bunu ortoptistinize veya optometristinize nasıl götürmeli.
- [Ushtrimet e syve: çfarë thotë kërkimi dhe si t'i ndjekësh](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/): A e përmirësojnë shikimin ushtrimet e syve? Çfarë mund dhe nuk mund të bëjnë, teknikat që përshkruajnë profesionistët, provat e CITT dhe Cochrane, dhe si të regjistrosh ushtrimet e përshkruara.
- [Pamjaftueshmëria e konvergjencës e shpjeguar: simptomat, diagnoza dhe kërkimet](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/pamjaftueshmeria-e-konvergjences): Çfarë është pamjaftueshmëria e konvergjencës, simptomat, si diagnostikohet dhe çfarë gjetën studimi CITT dhe rishikimi Cochrane. Udhëzues i thjeshtë; vendimet për trajtimin i merr profesionisti i syve.
- [Afrimi i lapsit dhe fija e Brock-ut të shpjeguara](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/afrimi-i-lapsit-dhe-fija-e-brockut): Si funksionojnë afrimi i lapsit dhe fija e Brock-ut, pse profesionistët i përshkruajnë për pamjaftueshmërinë e konvergjencës dhe çfarë gjeti studimi CITT.
- [Rregulli 20-20-20 dhe lodhja digjitale e syve: a funksionon?](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/rregulli-20-20-20): Çfarë është rregulli 20-20-20, çfarë është lodhja digjitale e syve, çfarë gjeti një studim i vitit 2022 për pushimet nga ekrani dhe këshillat e AOA për ekranin.
- [Mitet për ushtrimet e syve: pëllëmbët, metoda Bates, syzet](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/mitet): A mund t'i zëvendësojnë syzet ushtrimet e syve? Çfarë thonë organizatat e kujdesit për sytë për mbulimin me pëllëmbë, metodën Bates dhe ushtrimet për disleksinë.
- [Regjistri i ushtrimeve të syve: ndiq ushtrimet e përshkruara](https://ocufuse.com/sq/ushtrime-per-syte/regjistri-i-ushtrimeve): Çfarë të shënosh kur bën në shtëpi ushtrimet e përshkruara të syve, një format i thjeshtë regjistri dhe si ta çosh te ortoptisti ose optometristi.
- [Esercizi per gli occhi: cosa dice la ricerca e come registrarli](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/): Gli esercizi per gli occhi migliorano la vista? Cosa possono e non possono fare, le tecniche prescritte dai professionisti, le prove di CITT e Cochrane e come registrare gli esercizi prescritti.
- [Insufficienza di convergenza spiegata: sintomi, diagnosi e ricerca](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/insufficienza-di-convergenza): Cos'è l'insufficienza di convergenza, i sintomi, come si diagnostica e cosa hanno trovato lo studio CITT e la revisione Cochrane. Una guida semplice; le decisioni sul trattamento spettano al tuo professionista della vista.
- [Flessioni con la matita e cordino di Brock spiegati](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/flessioni-con-la-matita-e-cordino-di-brock): Come funzionano le flessioni con la matita e il cordino di Brock, perché i professionisti li prescrivono per l'insufficienza di convergenza e cosa ha scoperto lo studio CITT.
- [La regola 20-20-20 e l'affaticamento visivo digitale: funziona?](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/regola-20-20-20): Cos'è la regola 20-20-20, cos'è l'affaticamento visivo digitale, cosa ha scoperto uno studio del 2022 sulle pause dallo schermo e i consigli dell'AOA per lo schermo.
- [Miti sugli esercizi per gli occhi: palming, metodo Bates, occhiali](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/miti): Gli esercizi per gli occhi possono sostituire gli occhiali? Cosa dicono le organizzazioni per la salute degli occhi su palming, metodo Bates ed esercizi per la dislessia.
- [Registro degli esercizi per gli occhi: annota quelli prescritti](https://ocufuse.com/it/esercizi-per-gli-occhi/registro-degli-esercizi): Cosa annotare quando fai a casa gli esercizi per gli occhi prescritti, un formato di registro semplice e come portarlo all'ortottista o all'optometrista.
- [Vežbe za oči: šta kažu istraživanja i kako da ih pratiš](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/): Da li vežbe za oči poboljšavaju vid? Šta mogu, a šta ne mogu, tehnike koje propisuju stručnjaci, dokazi iz CITT i Cochrane studija i kako da beležiš propisane vežbe.
- [Insuficijencija konvergencije objašnjena: simptomi, dijagnoza i istraživanja](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/insuficijencija-konvergencije): Šta je insuficijencija konvergencije, simptomi, kako se dijagnostikuje i šta su pokazali studija CITT i Cochrane pregled. Jednostavan vodič; odluke o lečenju donosi tvoj stručnjak za oči.
- [Vežba sa olovkom i Brokov konac objašnjeni](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/vezba-sa-olovkom-i-brokov-konac): Kako funkcionišu vežba sa olovkom i Brokov konac, zašto ih stručnjaci propisuju za insuficijenciju konvergencije i šta je pokazala studija CITT.
- [Pravilo 20-20-20 i digitalno naprezanje očiju: da li deluje?](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/pravilo-20-20-20): Šta je pravilo 20-20-20, šta je digitalno naprezanje očiju, šta je studija iz 2022. pokazala o pauzama od ekrana i saveti AOA za ekran.
- [Mitovi o vežbama za oči: palming, Bejtsova metoda, naočare](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/mitovi): Mogu li vežbe za oči da zamene naočare? Šta organizacije za zdravlje očiju kažu o palmingu, Bejtsovoj metodi i vežbama za oči kod disleksije.
- [Dnevnik vežbi za oči: prati propisane vežbe](https://ocufuse.com/sr/vezbe-za-oci/dnevnik-vezbi): Šta da beležiš kada kod kuće radiš propisane vežbe za oči, jednostavan format dnevnika i kako da ga poneseš ortoptičaru ili optometristi.

## Blog
- [Sunglasses and UV: choosing a pair that protects](https://ocufuse.com/blog/sunglasses-and-uv-choosing-a-pair): A darker lens doesn't mean more protection, and an expensive pair isn't always better. What to look for in sunglasses, according to eye care and public health bodies.
- [Reading glasses after 40: what presbyopia is](https://ocufuse.com/blog/reading-glasses-after-40-presbyopia): Holding your phone further away to read it is one of the most common changes in midlife. What presbyopia is, why it happens, and the options an eye care professional may discuss.
- [Myopia in children: why time outdoors matters](https://ocufuse.com/blog/myopia-in-children-time-outdoors): Short-sightedness is becoming more common in children. What a large school trial found about outdoor time, and simple ways to fit more of it into the week.
- [How often should you get your eyes checked?](https://ocufuse.com/blog/how-often-should-you-get-your-eyes-checked): Many eye conditions don't cause symptoms early on. What UK and US eye care bodies recommend for routine eye tests, and who may need to go more often.
- [Contact lens habits that lower infection risk](https://ocufuse.com/blog/contact-lens-habits-infection-risk): Most contact lens wearers have at least one risky habit. The everyday steps eye care bodies recommend, from sleeping and water to cases and solution.
- [Dry eyes at work: small changes to your desk and day](https://ocufuse.com/blog/dry-eyes-at-work-desk-and-day): Air conditioning, screens and long meetings can leave eyes dry and gritty by the afternoon. Practical changes to your workspace and routine, and when dryness needs a professional.
- [Do blue light glasses help? What the research says](https://ocufuse.com/blog/do-blue-light-glasses-help): Blue light glasses are sold for eye strain, sleep and eye protection. A 2023 Cochrane review looked at the trials. Here is what the evidence does and doesn't show.
- [The 20-20-20 rule: what a 2023 study actually found](https://ocufuse.com/blog/20-20-20-rule-what-the-research-found): The 20-20-20 rule is one of the most repeated pieces of screen advice. A small study tested it with break reminders. Here is what changed, what didn't, and what it means for your day.
- [Diabetes and your eyes: why yearly screening matters](https://ocufuse.com/blog/diabetes-and-your-eyes-yearly-screening): Diabetes can affect the eyes long before you notice any change in your sight. Why regular eye checks are recommended, what screening involves, and how to prepare.
- [Sleep, screens and tired eyes](https://ocufuse.com/blog/sleep-screens-and-tired-eyes): Late-night scrolling, short sleep and tired eyes often go together. What the evidence says about screens before bed, and simple evening habits worth trying.
- [How to photograph your child's eyes for a doctor](https://ocufuse.com/blog/photographing-your-childs-eyes-for-the-eye-doctor): An eye that sometimes turns in or out often behaves perfectly at the appointment. How to capture useful photos and short videos of a child's eyes at home.
- [Red eye: when to watch it and when to see a doctor](https://ocufuse.com/blog/red-eye-when-to-see-a-doctor): Many red eyes are minor, but some need care the same day. The signs that separate the two, and what to note while you wait for an appointment.
- [Screen eye strain explained: causes, habits and when to get checked](https://ocufuse.com/blog/screen-eye-strain-what-helps): Tired, dry or blurry eyes after screen time? The habits with the best evidence, what blue light glasses really do, and when to get your eyes checked.
- [Double vision that comes and goes: what to note](https://ocufuse.com/blog/double-vision-that-comes-and-goes): If you sometimes see double, a few simple observations make your doctor's job easier. What to check, what to write down, and when double vision is an emergency.
- [Drooping eyelid: what to record and when it's urgent](https://ocufuse.com/blog/drooping-eyelid-what-to-record): When one eyelid sits lower than before, consistent photos help your doctor. How to take them, what to note, and the warning signs that cannot wait.
- [What to tell your eye doctor: a visit checklist](https://ocufuse.com/blog/what-to-tell-your-eye-doctor): Eye appointments are short. A practical checklist of what to bring, what to mention and which questions to ask so nothing gets forgotten.
- [Dry eye diary: a simple format your doctor can use](https://ocufuse.com/blog/how-to-keep-a-dry-eye-diary): Dry, gritty or watery eyes often depend on the day. A simple diary format that shows the pattern, plus what to bring to your appointment.
- [Eye twitching that won't stop: causes and notes](https://ocufuse.com/blog/eye-twitching-that-wont-stop): A twitching eyelid is common and usually settles on its own. What tends to set it off, what to write down, and when it is worth getting checked.
- [Why your eye photos look different day to day](https://ocufuse.com/blog/why-eye-photos-look-different-day-to-day): Two photos of the same eyes can look surprisingly different. The everyday reasons why, from light to camera angle, and what they do and don't tell you.
- [Eye symptoms that come and go: preparing for your visit](https://ocufuse.com/blog/preparing-for-an-eye-appointment-when-symptoms-come-and-go): Some eye symptoms disappear right before the appointment. How to keep a simple record so your doctor can see what happens on the other days.
- [How to take consistent eye photos at home](https://ocufuse.com/blog/how-to-take-consistent-eye-photos): Light, distance and angle change how your eyes look in a photo. Six habits that make daily eye photos comparable from one day to the next.

## Help and policies
- [Support Ocufuse: Help, Feedback and Ways to Help](https://ocufuse.com/support): Help with the Ocufuse web app and iPhone app, ways to support an independent team (Plus, sharing, feedback) and a contact form. We reply within 2 working days.
- [Privacy policy: how we handle your eye data](https://ocufuse.com/privacy): How Ocufuse collects, uses, stores and deletes your personal data, including eye photos and health-related journal entries.
- [Terms of use](https://ocufuse.com/terms): The terms that apply when you use Ocufuse, including the eye health journal web app, the iPhone app and the ocufuse.com website, and what you agree to.
- [Consumer health data privacy policy](https://ocufuse.com/consumer-health-data): How Ocufuse handles consumer health data under the Washington My Health My Data Act, Nevada law and similar US state laws, and how to use your rights.
- [Accessibility statement](https://ocufuse.com/accessibility): How Ocufuse supports VoiceOver, larger text, reduced motion and keyboard use on iPhone and ocufuse.com, the known limitations, and how to tell us about a barrier.
- [Delete your Ocufuse account and data](https://ocufuse.com/delete-account): How to delete your Ocufuse account, including all eye photos and journal entries, from the web app or iPhone app, and how long deletion takes.
- [Eye exercises and vision therapy FAQ](https://ocufuse.com/faq): 44 short, sourced answers about eye exercises, vision therapy, the 20-20-20 rule, amblyopia, strabismus and how to photograph your eyes for your doctor.
- [Contact Ocufuse: Support, Billing and Press](https://ocufuse.com/contact): Contact the Ocufuse team about the app, Ocufuse Plus billing, feedback or press. Send a message or email hello@ocufuse.com. We reply within 2 working days.
